items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce & Magento Open Source
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including unrestricted file upload, improper output encoding, stored XSS, and incorrect authorization issues, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Deserialization of untrusted data in Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension
items.summary: A critical deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension (versions prior to 1.11.12) allows unauthenticated remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie and has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves 15 CVEs in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, including critical Stored XSS (CVE-2026-34686) leading to arbitrary code execution and Path Traversal (CVE-2026-34653) allowing arbitrary file system writes.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API, named PolyShell, that enables unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files disguised as images, bypassing validation and leading to potential remote code execution.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute malicious code, and access store data. It fixes 19 CVEs, with several critical issues.
